scripts.env:validate:development: npx eas-cli@21.4.0 env:exec development "node ../../scripts/validate-mobile-environment.cjs --app client --environment development" --non-interactive
scripts.env:validate:preview: npx eas-cli@21.4.0 env:exec preview "node ../../scripts/validate-mobile-environment.cjs --app client --environment preview" --non-interactive
scripts.env:validate:production: npx eas-cli@21.4.0 env:exec production "node ../../scripts/validate-mobile-environment.cjs --app client --environment production" --non-interactive
scripts.eas:development: npm run env:validate:development && npx eas-cli@21.4.0 build --platform android --profile development
scripts.eas:preview: npm run env:validate:preview && npx eas-cli@21.4.0 build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.eas:production: npm run env:validate:production && npx eas-cli@21.4.0 build --platform android --profile production
